ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The James passage is translated from Tolstoy's Russian, not from an English Bible, and «господь Саваоф» (gospod' Savaof) is 'the Lord Sabaoth'; the full printed reference «Послание Иакова» (Poslanie Iakova, 'Epistle of James') is given as James 5:1–4. The rich Christian is the exposure of his «ложь» (lozh', 'lie'), and Chrysostom's «оковы» (okovy) and «узы» (uzy) are 'fetters' and 'bonds'.
